items.finding: The text notes that temperature sensitivity of OH bands poses a severe drawback for measuring aqueous solutions in NIR and MIR, requiring tempered sample holders.
items.how_it_applies: This highlights why tracking or controlling stream temperature is critical when evaluating NIR transmission or transflection options, suggesting that temperature compensation or auxiliary sensing should be tested.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The source discusses biopharmaceutical downstream processing in general rather than an on-line petroleum stream, so the exact thermal coefficients and sample holder requirements may differ.
